newsitem.title: USA: Investment Prop to sell assets for $255mln.
newsitem.headline: Investment Prop to sell assets for $255mln.

text.p: Investment Properties Associates said Tuesday that, subject to a number of conditions, it has agreed in principle to sell substantially all of its interests in its office building properties in a cash deal valued at about $255 million.
The company did not say whom the buyer is.
If completed, the proceeds of the sale would be used to repay indebtedness and other obligations of about $70 million, the company said.

The balance of the net proceeds would, after expenses, be distributed to the limited partners of the company and to the holders of its participations of limited partnership interest in accordance with its partnership agreement.
Investment Properties is a limited partnership that owns commercial office buildings in New York, Chicago, Texas and Newark.

Its properties are managed by Helmsley-Spear, a spokesman for the company said. Helmsley-Spear, a large management company, is a separate corporate entity from Helmsley Enterprises, whose holdings are wholly or partially owned by Leona Helmsley.
